summary: World Omni Auto Receivables LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a $1.2966 billion asset-backed note issuance by World Omni Auto Receivables Trust 2026-B. The agreement with BofA Securities, Mizuho, Truist, and U.S. Bancorp involves the sale of registered notes; no premium, price per share, or special-situation terms are present. The filing is a routine structured-finance securitization, not a special situation. What to watch: closing conditions and issuance on May 13, 2026.
